title: Topic
description: One word-list topic (a single file; entries carry their own per-language forms). See docs/PLANNING.md §4.

id.description: Kebab-case topic id; matches the topic's folder name (foldered) or file stem (flat).

titles.description: Optional per-language display names for a topic whose title translates (e.g. "South Park" stays global, but "SpongeBob SquarePants"/"SpongeBob Schwammkopf" differ). Absent when the name is identical everywhere; falls back to `title`.

languages.description: Languages this topic fully supports. The frontend flags a topic when the selected language isn't listed. Omit for a language-neutral list that reads the same in every locale.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the list's contents last actually changed.

lastChecked.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the list was last verified against its source (even if unchanged). Lets us spot which lists are due for a currency re-check.

namePair.description: An entry with a short (common) and long (full) name; the UI's per-group Names dropdown picks short / long / both.

langMap.description: A per-language entry: keys are language codes ("en" is the required base), values the localized word. Languages that match "en" are omitted from the map.

group.description: A subtopic; the smallest checkbox unit. Carries exactly one of `words` (flat) or `tiers` (fame-ordered).

titles.description: Optional per-language group titles, when the group name translates (e.g. "Characters"/"Charaktere").

tiers.description: Ordered fame tiers, tier 0 = most famous; order within a tier is irrelevant.

preset.description: A named bundle of group ids (e.g. "Include all").

groups.description: References to group ids in this topic; referential integrity is checked by validate-data, not the schema.
